conversion_policy: Prices, sizes and timestamps are exact; nothing is rounded. Source publisher and instrument IDs are kept; the channel is the source channel_id, or 0 when the file has none. NWT sequences restart at 1 per (publisher, channel); the source sequence number is not carried. Source flags are not carried. Every row -> QUOTE with the row's book columns (the top of book after the event). A trade (T) row also -> TRADE_QUOTE: on a trade row the book columns are the top of book at the trade. trade_id is 0 (the source has none); the side column is the aggressor. An absent side has no price in the source. A present side with a source order count of 0 gets a null count. TRADE records for the same prints come from the order-level file and go to a different container. Each instrument's definition comes from the venue's definition file and is written before its first record.
